caption_L1: This is a line diagram titled Deaths by homicide per 100,000 resident population in the U.S. from 1950 to 2017. The x-axis measures Year while the y-axis measures Homicide deaths per 100,000 resident population.
caption_L2L3: From 1960 to1980 there is a steep increase in the number of deaths - from approx 5 per 100 000 to over 10. After this the number decreases dramatically until around 2010, when the numbers start to rise again.
